column3: “joined” renders a verb (lavah) that plays on the name Levi.
“attend to your obligation” renders “keep your duty (mishmeret)” (throughout the chapter), and “the furnishings” renders “the articles.”
“the veil” renders “parokhet,” the curtain, and “a bestowed service” renders “a service of gift.”

“charge of My offerings” renders “the keeping of my contributions,” “a portion” renders “moshhah,” an anointed share, and “a perpetual allotment” renders “a prescribed portion of perpetuity” (also in verses 11 and 19).
“the most holy gifts” renders “the holy of holies,” and “render” renders “give back.”
“As the most holy gifts” renders “in the holy of holies,” which may also mean “in a most holy place.”
“the best” renders “the fat (helev)” (twice), and “the fresh wine” renders “tirosh.”
“you shall surely redeem” renders an emphatic doubled verb.
“offer as an offering” renders “offer up as a contribution.”
“present an offering” renders “offer up a contribution” (also in verses 28–29).
“the best of them” renders “their fat,” and “the sacred part” renders “its holy portion.”
“the best of it” renders “its fat,” and NASB supplies “the rest.”
